title: Kinship pack — .kinship.yaml
description: The machine-readable half of a Kinship pack: the agents, their permissions, the budgets, and the community's own declarations. THIS SCHEMA IS ADVICE. The gate is `scripts/validate-pack.mjs`, which refuses a pack that breaks an invariant; an editor that reads this file underlines a mistake before you run anything. A pack that satisfies this schema can still be refused by the gate — the schema is a superset of what the gate accepts, never a substitute for it. See spec/GOVERNANCE-SPEC-OUTLINE.md section 1.8 and CONTRIBUTING.md.

schema.description: The pack format version. A pack whose schema this runtime does not know is refused, never clamped (D35).

key.description: The namespaced pack key. `kinshipai/bundled/...` is held by the project; `kinshipai/community/...` is a fork's.

organisation.description: The tier above this pack. The org's manifest holds the floors; a pack may only be refused or have a blank filled — never widened (spec section 1.10).

bundled.description: True only for the project's own packs. A community pack may not claim the invariants the bundled one holds.

locale.description: The language pair the member-facing copy is carried in. This runtime implements id+en and en+ar; a pair it does not implement is refused at boot.

agents.description: The pack's agents, and the action classes each may hold.

autonomy_by_class.description: The action class -> level map. A class that is not here is ABSENT from this agent's toolset, not denied at runtime — a reviewer greps the tool list and finds nothing.

additionalProperties.description: `draft` needs a human. `opt-in-auto` runs only for a class the organiser enabled. `never` means the capability does not exist here.

tools.description: The tool list, as `channel | action`. A mutating moderation tool is refused (PKG-30).

report_aggregation_floor.description: A report may not name a member until this many are in the cohort.

member_message_cap_per_24h.description: How many messages one member may receive in a day. A member protection, not a setting.

identity_disclosure.description: Whether member-facing copy must disclose itself.

llm_per_event_idr.description: The ceiling on the fleet's model spend for one event, in rupiah. Unset refuses spend (fail closed).

max_actions_per_run.description: How many actions one run may attempt. Per RUN, and a run is the handle the caller holds.

needs.description: The answers the community supplies and the fleet will never invent. The pack names them; the community's own file answers them; the runtime refuses to boot without every one.

mode.description: `staffed` names the hours a human is on duty; `always` names no window and no zone.

timezone.description: An IANA zone, e.g. `Asia/Jakarta`. 'Business hours without a time zone is not a commitment.'

windows.description: The staffed windows, as a LIST — because a community's week may be split.

posture.description: How this community is run. The org holds a floor; the pack may only be stricter.

contact.description: May the fleet approach a member at all?

discoverable.description: May the fleet find members who have not asked?

sanction_ladder.description: What this community does when someone breaks a rule. Declared as DATA; the fleet may still not carry any rung out (PKG-63).

by.description: The human seat that acts. A rung whose `by` is not a seat is refused.

attribution.description: Who wrote this pack, and what it was donated from. Part of the pack's hash.
